text: Tidewatch business. Keep your nose clean.
Halt! I know that face! ...I'm off duty in five minutes. Run.
There's a price on you. Don't make me earn it.
An honour, captain. The lads talk about you.
Seen anything moving on the water? Good. Keep it that way.
Can't see a thing in this. Perfect night for the dead to come ashore.

options.label: What's it like in the Tidewatch?

text: Patrols, mostly. Searching pockets for untaxed rum. Shooting at things that should be dead.
There's been ghost ships off the north point. Commodore says to double the watch.
The pay's bad, the food's worse, and the dead don't stay dead. But the coat's nice.
Joined for the adventure. Got guard duty. Story of every marine.
